name: GMCU (Goulburn Murray Credit Union)
legalName: Goulburn Murray Credit Union Co-operative Limited

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: GMCU does not publish a policy maximum LVR. The only LVR figures on the site are eligibility conditions attached to advertised rates (all 80% or below) - see lvr.notes. Whether GMCU lends above 80% with LMI is not published.

notes.value: The only published LVR figures are rate-eligibility footnotes on the home loans page, all capped at 80%: (footnote 3) "Interest rate is only available to owner-occupied loans on our Standard Variable Plus, 1, 2 or 3 Year Fixed Rate principal and interest repayments with less than or equal to 80% Loan to Value Ratio (LVR). After fixed rate period, loan will revert to Standard Variable Plus product, applicable to the Loan to Value Ratio (LVR)." (footnote 4) "Interest rate is only available on investment loans on our Standard Variable Plus Investment, 1, 2 or 3 Year Fixed Rate Investment principal and interest repayments with less than or equal to 80% Loan to Value Ratio (LVR)." (footnote 1, construction) "eligibility criteria: home loans to personal individual borrowers with new borrowings between $150,000 and $750,000 and maximum Loan to Valuation ratio of 80%; must be single dwelling construction with fixed price building contract". These are pricing conditions, not a stated policy ceiling.
notes.sourceTitle: GMCU - View all home loans, footnotes 1, 3 and 4
notes.note: The page carries no effective date; asAt is the date observed (29 Jul 2026).
No credit-history policy is published on gmcu.com.au.

constructionAvailable.note: A "Construction Fixed Rate" product is advertised: "Make your dream build a reality, with the construction of your new home." Footnote 1 requires "single dwelling construction with fixed price building contract" and new borrowings between $150,000 and $750,000 at maximum 80% LVR.

offsetAvailable.note: "100% Offset" is listed as a feature on select products (Standard Variable Plus / Standard Variable Plus Investment). Not available on every product.

redrawAvailable.note: Redraw and unrestricted additional repayments are listed among the product features on the home loans index.

notes.value: GMCU (Goulburn Murray Credit Union Co-operative Ltd) is a Victorian credit union headquartered in Shepparton with roughly 20,000 members across about 10 branches. MEMBERSHIP IS OPEN, NOT OCCUPATION-RESTRICTED: "Our constitution allows us to accept and approve membership for natural persons and bodies corporate", and "Each approved member is required to subscribe to become a shareholder. Members who already hold a share may open additional memberships without being required to take out additional shares." Four home loan products are advertised: Construction Fixed Rate, Fixed Rate, Standard Variable Plus and Standard Variable Plus Investment. GMCU's membership page notes disclosure documents are being updated "effective 1 August 2026" for new account launches and policy changes. NO BROKER CHANNEL WAS FOUND: no broker page, aggregator panel, accreditation form or third-party lending guide exists on the site.
notes.sourceTitle: GMCU - Membership (corporate information); View all home loans

gaps: No broker channel could be found - GMCU appears to be direct-to-member only. Confirm before putting it on a panel.

No policy maximum LVR is published for either owner occupied or investment lending; the only LVR figures are 80% pricing-eligibility conditions. Whether GMCU lends above 80% with LMI, and who its LMI provider is, is not published.
No credit policy document or serviceability calculator is published: nothing on assessment buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, HEM or credit card assessment.
No general minimum or maximum loan amount is published - the $150,000 to $750,000 range is an eligibility condition of the discounted construction fixed rate only.
No maximum loan term is published.
No income-type, employment tenure, credit-history, security/property or residency policy is published.
GMCU's ABN and Australian Credit Licence number were not captured from a public page in this pass.
GMCU disclosure documents are being updated effective 1 August 2026 - this record should be re-checked after that date.
